acceptance: Both certifi bundles inside the installed gcloud-cli contain neither emSign ECC Root CA - G3 nor AAA Certificate Services
`gcloud config get core/custom_ca_certs_file` reports the property as unset
`gcloud projects list --limit=1` and `bq ls` succeed after the override is removed
context: Cleared the hold early: gcloud-cli 590.0.1 (released after the item was filed) ships no affected roots in any bundled certifi or botocore copy; verified and applied 2026-10-23.
description:
Google Cloud CLI 590.0.0 still bundles two certifi copies that trust the roots the compromised eMudhra emSign intermediates chain to: `lib/third_party/certifi` (2026.02.25, trusts emSign ECC Root CA - G3) and `platform/bq/third_party/certifi` (2021.10.08, trusts emSign ECC Root CA - G3 and AAA Certificate Services). Both accepted the incident checker chains. As a workaround on the maintainer's Mac, gcloud and bq verify TLS against Homebrew's patched ca-certificates bundle instead:

- `gcloud config set core/custom_ca_certs_file /opt/homebrew/etc/ca-certificates/cert.pem`
- `~/.bigqueryrc` containing `--ca_certificates_file=/opt/homebrew/etc/ca-certificates/cert.pem` (the file did not exist before the workaround).

The override ties gcloud to Homebrew's bundle path; if that path disappears, gcloud fails closed. Remove it once a gcloud-cli release ships bundles without the affected roots, so gcloud returns to its vendor-maintained trust store.

Steps:
1. `brew upgrade --cask gcloud-cli`, then check both bundles: `rg -c 'emSign ECC Root CA - G3|AAA Certificate Services'` on `$(gcloud info --format='value(installation.sdk_root)')/lib/third_party/certifi/cacert.pem` and `.../platform/bq/third_party/certifi/cacert.pem` must find nothing (or both certifi copies are 2026.10.18 or newer).
2. `gcloud config unset core/custom_ca_certs_file`.
3. Delete `~/.bigqueryrc` (or only the `--ca_certificates_file` line if other settings were added since).
4. Confirm `gcloud projects list --limit=1` and `bq ls` still work.

If the release is still unfixed, leave the override in place and push `not_before` out again.
